data.desc: mF International Limited (MFI) is a Nasdaq-listed fintech company dedicated to building foundational infrastructure for the digital asset ecosystem. Originally established as a provider of advanced trading platform solutions for forex (FX) and precious metals serving global institutional clients, MFI has evolved under new leadership to become an architect of the digital asset -native ecosystem. Current business initiatives include the first Bitcoin Cash (BCH) digital asset treasury (DAT) strategy on Nasdaq, the development of BCH self-mining capacity and operations, and an anticipated digital asset -denominated life insurance business.
